tidbit: Did you know… a story marked Still open means nobody on the record has confirmed it yet.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Google's copyright case over Gemini is back on the EU court calendar. Reported by MLex: an EU court adviser will issue an opinion on November 3.
Google DeepMind's AlphaProof Nexus solved 9 Erdős problems and 44 conjectures. Confirmed by The Decoder: the work was peer-reviewed by Science.
Amazon is reportedly eyeing a 7 billion dollar deal with Decart. Still open per The Times of India: Anthropic had previously offered 6 billion dollars for the startup.
Nvidia reportedly discontinues the GeForce RTX 5090 but may launch the RTX 5080 24GB. Still open according to Club386: the launch is planned for Q1 2027.
Andrew Garfield stars in the film Artificial, which explores artificial intelligence leadership and power dynamics. Reported by India Today: Garfield plays Altman in the movie.
Free every hour.
